_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft compiled 2026-09-26. Scoped to individually identifiable figures directly linked by sources to the Fredy Pratama network. Police claims remain allegations; first-instance or appellate verdicts are labeled at their proven stage and do not imply exhausted remedies or current custody. A 60-suspect police aggregate is not used as a roster. Map regions indicate evidenced historical organizational activity, never arrest venue, nationality, or residence alone. No precise locations, routes, live whereabouts, enforcement details, or photos without verified reuse rights. Rivaldo’s 2024 verdict is cited to accessible court reporting; his full name is supported by the prosecutor report, which uses a longer form than the verdict article.
